samples.scenario: A publicly accessible Google Cloud Storage bucket was found containing unencrypted backup files of a financial application database, exposing sensitive financial records and credentials. The bucket was accessed anonymously via an automated vulnerability scanner.

technical_data.http_request:
GET /finance-app-backups/db_backup_2024-05-12.sql HTTP/1.1
Host: storage.googleapis.com
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Google-Cloud-Security-Scanner)
Accept-Encoding: identity

indicators: Audit logs showing anonymous storage.objects.get calls
Bucket IAM policy binding includes 'allUsers' with objectViewer role
HTTP GET requests from known scanner user agents
Unencrypted backup SQL dump containing card data and financial transactions
Use of gsutil to copy objects without authentication
samples.detection_method: Continuous audit log analysis for unauthenticated access to storage objects, automated scanning of bucket IAM policies for public bindings, anomaly detection on traffic patterns from security scanner user agents and unusual IP addresses, integration with Cloud Security Command Center for bucket misconfigurations, and scheduled encryption compliance checks on storage objects.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
T1078 - Valid Accounts (anonymous access via public bucket)
T1560.001 - Archive Collected Data: Archive via Cloud Storage
T1537 - Transfer Data to Cloud Account

samples.scenario: An Azure Blob Storage container configured with public read access was discovered exposing internal project documentation and API keys. External parties accessed the container anonymously using Azure Storage REST API, resulting in sensitive intellectual property leakage.

technical_data.http_request:
GET /project-docs/api_keys.txt HTTP/1.1
Host: devstorageaccount.blob.core.windows.net
User-Agent: Azure-Storage/1.0 (REST API)
Accept-Encoding: identity
technical_data.downloaded_file_snippet:
API_KEY=ABCD1234EFGH5678IJKL
API_SECRET=ZYXW9876VUTS5432RQPO
# DO NOT SHARE

Project: Internal payment gateway
Last updated: 2024-04-30
technical_data.azure_cli_command_used_by_attacker: az storage blob download --container-name project-docs --name api_keys.txt --account-name devstorageaccount --output none

indicators: Azure activity logs showing anonymous read operations on blobs
Blob container ACL set to allow public blob-level access
HTTP GET request from unknown IPs targeting storage blobs
Downloaded text files containing sensitive API keys and internal documentation
Use of Azure CLI to download blobs without authentication
samples.detection_method: Monitor Azure Activity Logs for anonymous or unauthorized blob read actions, enforce Azure Storage container access policies to restrict public access, use Azure Defender for Storage to detect suspicious access patterns, implement alerts on downloads of sensitive file types, and conduct regular access reviews and penetration testing on storage accounts.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
T1078 - Valid Accounts (anonymous access via public blob container)
T1560.001 - Archive Collected Data: Archive via Cloud Storage
T1537 - Transfer Data to Cloud Account
